name: Buffy the Vampire Slayer PC Port

inputs.label: Your Buffy the Vampire Slayer (2002) game for the original Xbox, European (PAL) release: a disc image (.iso or .xiso).

prepare.label: Installing the game from your disc image and building it on your PC (about 8 minutes; the compiler comes with the download)

exit_codes.1: Installing or building the game failed, or the disc image isn't the European (PAL) release of Buffy the Vampire Slayer (Xbox, 2002) this port supports. The details are in install_log.txt in the Game folder. Setting up again carries on where it stopped.
exit_codes.2: The game's files were installed, but the download is incomplete: buffy_tvs.exe is missing beside the launcher. Install the port again.

actions.label: Problem reports
actions.help: Folders made with Report a Problem or F12.
